sample_unit: patient cases (vignettes) with a drug-drug interaction

links.outcome: Quality and safety of LLM DDI management recommendations versus ground truth
links.effect: GPT-4 recommendations optimal in 8/13 (61.5%) cases (P=0.05 vs ground truth); two GPT-4 and one Gemini 1.5 recommendation deemed to result in potential patient harm.
links.quote: Two recommendations from GPT-4 and one recommendation from Gemini 1.5 were deemed to result in potential patient harm.

screen.reason: Evaluates the baseline accuracy and safety of three commercial LLMs (GPT-4, Gemini 1.5, Claude 3) in identifying drug-drug interactions and generating recommendations across 15 simulated patient vignettes, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
